caption_L1: Top global oil companies by proved oil reserves in 2013 (in million barrels) is a bar diagram. The x-axis shows Reserves in million barrels while the y-axis shows leading world gas and oil companies.
caption_L2L3: OJSC Rosneft Oil Company has the highest amount of oil reserves in 2013, but it is also the only company with reserves above 30,000. 60% of the companies have oil reserves between 10,000 and 20,000. None of the companies shown here have reserves below 10,000 and only 30% have reserves between 5,000 and 10,000.
